- Targets: p50 < 400ms, p95 < 1.0s for one-turn replies; p95 < 1.8s acceptable for multi-turn flows.

Perf tuning suggestions discussed (AE/SE notes):
- Region choice: recommend moving primary endpoints to us-west-2 or us-west-1 for majority-of-users West Coast traffic; run A/B: us-east-1 vs us-west-2 over 48h, measure p50/p95.
- Prompt guidance: separate static menu (embed + retrieval or vector DB) instead of including full menu in every turn; use short system prompts and structured few-shot examples; aim for <300 token prompts for common queries.
- Timeout settings: advise client timeout >= 10s for reservation flows, and keep optimistic 3-4s for one-line confirmations but degrade gracefully (show still-typing state). Suggest server-side idle/response timeout set to 30s.
- Streaming: enable streaming (chunked) to improve perceived latency for user facing UI; will reduce apparent wait even if model token time similar.
- Batching/caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated small confirmations; recommend caching common responses for menu items.
- Model/routing: try smaller, faster model for confirmations; route multi-turn reservation flows to higher-capacity model variant.
